description: Create a skill and attach it to the installed plugin. `prompt` is the inline SKILL.md body; `description` is usually required metadata, and missing required metadata fails instead of prompting. Then regenerates the installed plugin locally, like `athenode init` without confirmation (the result adds `install` and `regeneration`, whose `pluginChanges` lists the tools whose plugin package or declaration was rewritten, with `suppressedIn` naming another tool's local settings file the plugin was switched off in; `missingEnvVars` is checked against the MCP server's environment, not your shell). If regeneration fails, the backend change is still saved and the tool returns an error. Requires an installed plugin (`npx @athenode/cli init`), unless `pluginId` names another plugin of the project: that one is changed on the server only, with no local regeneration.

metadata.description: Metadata fields to set, as {key: value}; "<target>.<field>" sets a per-target field (target: claudecode, codexcli, cursor, copilot, copilotcli, opencode, antigravity-ide, antigravity-cli, devin, junie, kiro-ide, kiro-cli, kilo, factorydroid, grokcli, qoder, commandcode, codewhale, mimocode, zcode, vibe, rovodev, zoocode, pool, qwencode, codebuddy, augmentcode, goose, kimi-code, deepagents, omp, reasonix, bob). Booleans and numbers may be JSON values or strings; list fields an array or a comma-separated string. Unlisted metadata is kept on update.

pluginId.description: Id of the plugin to act on (see plugins_list); the installed plugin if omitted (CLI: --plugin-id).
